    GenAI & RAG Pipeline LangChain · Vector DB

    RAG-Powered PDF Chatbot

    Engineered an AI-powered document intelligence chatbot using a Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipeline to answer complex queries directly from uploaded PDF documents with minimal hallucinations.

    • Implemented automated text chunking, document preprocessing, and semantic search via LangChain.
    • Integrated vector embeddings and a vector database for low-latency context retrieval.
    • Tuned retrieval grounding prompts for accurate, context-aware answers.
    Python LangChain RAG Vector Embeddings

    Patient Management System API

    High-performance RESTful backend built with FastAPI and MySQL to manage patient registrations, clinical histories, and appointment schedules with full CRUD operations.

    • Designed relational MySQL schema for structured clinical and patient record integrity.
    • Built Pydantic validation models, JWT/OAuth2 authentication patterns, and exception handlers.
    • Configured interactive Swagger UI / OpenAPI documentation for rapid endpoint testing.
    Python FastAPI MySQL Swagger UI
